simple.meaning: נַחְנוּ (nachnûw) is a Hebrew object word meaning “we.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 42:11. The surrounding context includes family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נַחְנוּ (H5168) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: נַחְנוּ (nachnûw) / H5168 is traced through Genesis 42:11, Exodus 16:7, Exodus 16:8, Numbers 32:32 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H5168. nachnu נָחְ֑נוּ נַ֫חְנוּ, pronoun 1 plural we (abbreviated from אֲנַחְנוּ ; compare the forms , נַחְנָא , just cited; also Assyrian nîni ) Gen 42:11 ; Exod 16:7-8 , Num 32:32 ; Lam 3:42 . (In 2Sam 17:12 נַחְנוּ is 1 plural perfect Qal from נוּחַ .)

occurrences.englishText: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”
In the morning, you shall see Yahweh’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against Yahweh. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”
We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
